name: kstyletrip
description: Last trains, concert shuttles and stays a walk away for every K-pop concert night in Korea.

interface.longDescription:
K-Style Trip helps overseas fans get home safely after a K-pop concert in Korea and find a place to stay near the venue.

Ask in any language about a show at KSPO DOME, INSPIRE Arena, Gocheok Sky Dome, Olympic Hall, Jamsil Arena, KINTEX, KBS Arena and other venues in Seoul, Incheon and Goyang. K-Style Trip finds the show and answers with a card for that night:
- Way home: the last trains from the venue's nearest station on that night's timetable (weekday, or weekend and public holiday), whether they reach central Seoul, the minutes to spare after the show, and whether a concert shuttle is sold to foreign fans, with its order deadline, fares and terms.
- Stays nearby: the hotels and guesthouses nearest the venue with walking minutes, opened on that night's dates, and whether free cancellation can still be filtered.

Every figure comes from K-Style Trip's own checks of timetables, venues and seller pages, with the date it was checked.

Who it is for: fans travelling from Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia and beyond who hold a ticket and need to plan the night.

Limitations: it covers shows in K-Style Trip's concert calendar (collected daily from Korea's official performance register); artist names work best in their official Latin spelling. Prices and rooms left are live on the booking page, not in the card. K-Style Trip does not sell anything or take payment inside ChatGPT: booking buttons open third-party sellers (Agoda, Trip.com, KKday, Klook) through affiliate links, at the same price to the user. The foreign-fan shuttles are not sold to Korean nationals. Always check the operator's own notice on the day.

positive.description: Japanese fan asks how to get back to central Seoul after a show at INSPIRE Arena (Incheon), which has no station within walking distance.
positive.prompt: 優里の12月5日のインスパイアアリーナ公演、終わったあとソウル市内までどうやって帰ればいいですか？
positive.expected_behavior: Finds YUURI on 5 Dec 2026 at INSPIRE Arena and shows the way-home card in Japanese: last trains from Incheon Airport Terminal 2 station (23:32 toward Seoul Station, reaching central Seoul; 23:50 toward Digital Media City), the foreign-fan shuttle with its order deadline (3 Dec), and buttons for the shuttle, airport pickup and the K-Style Trip page.

positive.description: Japanese fan asks for a hotel near INSPIRE Arena on a show night.
positive.prompt: 12月6日に優里のライブでインスパイアアリーナに行きます。会場の近くに泊まれるホテルはありますか？
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the stays card in Japanese for the night of 6 Dec 2026: the nearest hotels to the venue (the resort hotel marked as the same complex as the venue), each button opening Agoda on 6-7 Dec, plus buttons for stays around the venue with free cancellation, a map and an eSIM.

positive.description: English-speaking fan asks whether the subway reaches central Seoul after a Saturday show at KSPO DOME.
positive.prompt: I'm seeing DAVICHI at KSPO DOME on December 12. Will the subway still get me to central Seoul after the show?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the way-home card in English for Sat 12 Dec 2026 on the weekend timetable: last trains 23:49 toward Gunja and 23:53 toward Macheon from Olympic Park station, with a red line saying they do not reach central Seoul, and the minutes to spare after a show assumed to run about three hours.

positive.description: Taiwanese fan asks in Traditional Chinese for a stay within walking distance of KSPO DOME.
positive.prompt: 12月13日 DAVICHI 在 KSPO DOME 的演唱會，附近有走路可以回去的住宿嗎？
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the stays card in Traditional Chinese for the night of 13 Dec 2026: Seoul Olympic Parktel (about 6 minutes on foot) and the nearest guesthouses with walking minutes, each opening Agoda on that night's dates.

positive.description: Korean fan asks for the last subway after a concert at Olympic Hall.
positive.prompt: 12월 5일 비(RAIN) 올림픽홀 콘서트 끝나고 지하철 막차 몇 시예요?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the way-home card in Korean for Sat 5 Dec 2026 at Olympic Hall with that night's last trains from the nearest station and their direction. No shuttle row, because the foreign-fan shuttle is not sold to Korean readers.

negative.description: Restaurant recommendation unrelated to a concert night.
negative.prompt: Recommend a good Korean BBQ restaurant near Myeongdong.

negative.description: How to buy concert tickets (K-Style Trip does not sell or broker tickets).
negative.prompt: How do I buy tickets for a K-pop concert on NOL Interpark?
What's the weather in Seoul tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: No purchase or payment happens inside ChatGPT. Booking buttons open third-party sellers (Agoda, Trip.com, KKday, Klook) through affiliate links; K-Style Trip may earn a commission, and the user's price is the same.

publication.release_notes: First public release: way-home and stays-near cards for concert nights in Korea, in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, English, Korean and French.

ja-JP.subtitle: 韓国のK-POP公演の夜を安心に
ja-JP.description: 韓国でK-POP公演を見る海外ファンのために、終演後の帰り方と会場近くの宿を、その夜の情報でお知らせします。KSPO DOME・インスパイアアリーナ・高尺スカイドームなどの公演を聞くと、その夜の終電（平日・土日祝ダイヤ）がソウル中心部まで行くか、外国人向けシャトルの受付締切・料金、会場から歩いて帰れる宿をカードで表示します。予約ボタンは提携の販売サイト（アゴダ・Trip.com・KKday・Klook）を開き、お支払い額は変わりません。

zh-TW.subtitle: 韓國K-POP演唱會之夜
zh-TW.description: 為來韓國看 K-POP 演唱會的海外粉絲，用當晚的資訊告訴你散場後怎麼回去、場館附近住哪裡。詢問 KSPO DOME、INSPIRE Arena、高尺巨蛋等場館的演出，就會以卡片顯示當晚的末班車（平日或週末假日時刻）是否到得了首爾市中心、外國人接駁車的預約截止與價格，以及走路可到的住宿。訂房按鈕會打開合作平台（Agoda、Trip.com、KKday、Klook），你付的價格不變。

ko-KR.subtitle: 한국 K팝 공연 밤 길잡이
ko-KR.description: 한국에서 K팝 공연을 보는 해외 팬에게 공연 끝나고 돌아가는 길과 공연장 가까운 숙소를 그 밤의 정보로 알려 드립니다. KSPO DOME · 인스파이어 아레나 · 고척스카이돔 등의 공연을 물으면 그 밤 막차(평일 · 주말 공휴일 시간표)가 서울 도심까지 가는지, 외국인 셔틀 접수 마감 · 요금, 걸어서 돌아올 숙소를 카드로 보여 줍니다. 예약 단추는 제휴 판매처(아고다 · Trip.com · KKday · Klook)를 열며 내는 값은 같습니다.

fr-FR.subtitle: Soirs de concert K-pop
fr-FR.description: Pour les fans étrangers venus voir un concert de K-pop en Corée : comment rentrer après le concert et où dormir près de la salle, avec les informations du soir même. Demandez un concert à la KSPO DOME, l'INSPIRE Arena, le Gocheok Sky Dome et d'autres salles : une carte indique les derniers métros (semaine ou week-end et jours fériés) et s'ils atteignent le centre de Séoul, la date limite et les tarifs de la navette pour fans étrangers, et les hébergements à pied. Les boutons ouvrent des vendeurs partenaires (Agoda, Trip.com, KKday, Klook), au même prix.
